drop.why: crc3178 contains the string 'green' 0 times and says nothing about diurnal range; the cell's claim is that fruit stays green-skinned and low in sugar where the climate lacks a warm-day cool-night swing. No UCR accession page carries that claim: it is climate-quality, which is outside ucr_citrus's own citable_for. Trevor's ruling 2026-09-20: DROP the credit rather than move it.

entry.summary: failure_diagnostics[0] (fruit stays green and tart) lost its ucr_citrus credit at PLA-465's anchor repair (2026-09-20). The cited page was https://citrusvariety.ucr.edu/crc3178, the Frost Owari Satsuma accession, which contains 'green' 0 times and carries nothing on diurnal range. THE CLAIM IS NOT LEFT UNCITED, and the ruling was taken on the premise that it would be: the drop leaves uhawaii_ctahr (CTAHR F&N-14, https://www.ctahr.hawaii.edu/oc/freepubs/pdf/F_N-14.pdf, 266558 bytes, sha256 4d2a3549ec909ea85fc8be84efaea8ef3ed44ad31b4d8ee9547539c7eafaef47), read from raw bytes 2026-09-20, which carries the COLOR half verbatim: 'Fruit of citruses such as orange and tangerine usually fails to develop color when grown at Hawaii's lower elevations, and a green or green-yellow skin coloration is normal in ripe fruit. In areas with cooler nights, the fruits turn bright orange upon ripening.' THE SUGAR HALF IS NOT MERELY UNSUPPORTED, IT IS CONTRADICTED BY THE SURVIVING SOURCE, and those are different states that a later pass must not conflate. UNSUPPORTED means the page is silent and a hunt may still find the claim intact elsewhere. CONTRADICTED means the page that was actually read makes the OPPOSITE attribution, so a later hunt has to reconcile with it, not merely add to it. This is the second state. The record's claim is that fruit runs low in sugar in the warm humid lowlands for want of cool nights; CTAHR attributes low sugar to the opposite condition, cooler HIGH elevations, saying of trees grown in or above the 500 to 1000 ft range 'where cooler temperatures are common, the fruit may fail to develop high levels of sugar'. So the record joins green skin and low sugar under one diurnal-swing cause that its own cited page splits into two opposed ones. Do not read this entry as 'a citation is missing' and assume the contradiction is still unchecked: it was checked on 2026-09-20 from raw bytes, and it is a contradiction.
entry.resolution_note: Trevor's ruling 2026-09-20: drop the ucr_citrus credit, and do NOT run the targeted read in this promote. What that read now owes is narrower than the ruling assumed: not a re-citation of the claim, which uhawaii_ctahr already carries for color, but a T1 statement on whether the low-sugar half shares the cool-night mechanism. UF/IFAS or TAMU on citrus color break and degreening are the likely homes. Until then the sugar clause stands on the cited page's contrary attribution and should not be read as sourced.

entry.summary: regions.ca_south_coast.resolved_by_zone 9, 10 and 11 each claim a harvest window that spans two cultivars whose evidence is on two different UCR accession pages: 'Dec - Mar (early satsuma through late Pixie and Gold Nugget)', noted as 'the home of the famous Ojai Pixie and of excellent clementine and Gold Nugget crops'. anchoring_urls holds ONE url per source key, so the ucr_citrus key cannot carry both ends. The early end is crc3178 (satsuma, ripeness Oct to Dec); the late end is crc3568 (Pixie, 'matures in late winter and holds exceptionally late on the tree') or crc3913 (Gold Nugget, ripeness February to June, which is what reaches the cell's March end). All three were read from raw bytes 2026-09-20 and none carries the span. THIS IS NOT A MANDARIN DEFECT: it reaches any region cell bounded by an early variety at one end and a late one at the other. Same family as plum_self_fertile_boolean_european_default, which states the general form as one record, two types, a single-value shape that breaks wherever they diverge.
entry.resolution_note: Trevor's ruling 2026-09-20: LEAVE HELD, do not repoint. Picking one accession would silently credit it for the other end's half of the claim. The three cells stay on crc3178 and the structural question is filed as its own ticket, PLA-559, linked to plum's type-aware finding as the same family. Resolve these cells under that ticket's ruling, not separately.
